item.title: [WATCHLIST: county commission] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] ‘We cannot fight crime in the Stone Age’: Pinellas sheriff defends Flock cameras
item.description: Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri is defending Flock and other license plate cameras as important crime-fighting tools, even as a county commissioner pushes to remove them from county roads.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Billy Adams sentencing: Tampa jury recommends death for unborn child's killing
item.description: A jury recommended Wednesday that Tampa rapper Billy Adams be put to death for the killing of his pregnant girlfriend's unborn child.

item.description: Hillsborough County is tightening its rules for short-term rental properties following complaints from neighbors about noise, parking and disruptive guests.
